name: Your Company
tagline: Art forging worth a closer look
niche: Art forging: bespoke gates, railings, grilles and decor

seo.title: Your Company — bespoke art forging in Tashkent
seo.description: Forged gates, railings, window grilles, gazebos and decor from bespoke sketches. Workshop in Mirzo Ulugbek, a portfolio of work, installation across Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is an art forging workshop in Mirzo Ulugbek: forged gates from 2,400,000 UZS per m², railings from 1,300,000 UZS per metre, window grilles from 750,000 UZS per m² and gazebos from 38,000,000 UZS. Free sketch, 3–6 weeks lead time, 5-year warranty; phone +998 71 200-04-07.

listing.description: A website for an art forging workshop: a portfolio laid out like film, a contact sheet of work, packages and order stages.

sections.title: Metal that draws
sections.subtitle: Gates, railings, grilles and gazebos from sketches drawn for your house. Every scroll is forged by hand — no two of our pieces are alike.

items.title: Vineyard gates
items.text: Four-metre swing gates with vines and grapes and a gold patina.

items.title: Wave railing
items.text: A three-storey spiral stair with a walnut handrail.

items.title: Garden gazebo
items.text: An octagonal gazebo with a forged dome and lantern.

items.title: Girih grilles
items.text: An oriental pattern for twelve windows of an old house in the mahalla.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: We draw before we forge
sections.text: An artist and four smiths work in the shop. We draw sketches at 1:10 against your house’s facade, and complex elements full size on the layout floor. We work with girih patterns, plant motifs and classic scrolls.

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.quote: They redrew the gate sketch three times until it matched the pattern on our door. Now the neighbours ask where we ordered it.
items.author: Oybek

items.quote: The gazebo went up in two days and the dome matches the drawing exactly.
items.author: Gulnora

items.a: No, the sketch and revisions are free. If you order, the sketch is yours to keep.
Grilles take about 3 weeks, gates and railings 4–5 weeks, gazebos up to 6 weeks.

items.q: Can you copy a pattern from a photo?
items.a: We can use a photo as a starting point and draw our own version to fit your opening.
Zinc-rich primer, forge paint and, if you like, patina or gold leaf.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come and see the work in person
sections.text: 88 Mustakillik Ave, Mirzo Ulugbek. Mon–Sat 9:00–18:00 — sample gates and railings are on show in the workshop.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: In stock
